text: APPROVE: The extracted helper `WholeArrayArgumentBounds` moves the label, `[`, matching-bracket and trailing-comma checks verbatim and returns the same nulls, so behaviour is unchanged, and removing four early-return `if`s (some with compound conditions) from `LiteralStringArrayArgument` should drop its complexity by more than the 1 needed, while the new code is straightforward C# (a nullable tuple with `.Value` and deconstruction) that should compile without warnings.
